en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a rural scene with two large haystacks being transported on wagons pulled by oxen. Several people are working in the field, loading or driving the wagons. In the background, there are rows of tall, slender trees and low mountains or hills. The postcard has a white border with printed text in Spanish and French, as well as a publisher's mark on the left edge.
